campaign.title: Email 7: Consultation
campaign.email_subject: A free 20 minutes with me, if it helps
campaign.email_pre_header: Walk away with a plan, even if it isn’t GravityKit.
campaign.email_body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}}, quick chat?

It’s Zack here, the founder of GravityKit. 👋 You’ve heard from us a few times this week. I noticed you got close to checking out and then stepped away. That’s completely fine!

💬 But if you’re stuck, let’s just talk

Instead of sending you another sales email, I want to offer something different. Grab 20 minutes on my calendar (completely free) and we can talk through whatever’s on your mind:

  • The project you’re trying to build, and whether GravityKit is actually the right tool for it
  • A specific Gravity Forms problem you’ve been wrestling with
  • Questions about a plugin, a use case, or how a few of them fit together
  • Or anything else you want a second opinion on

Book a Free Consultation

No pitch, no pressure. If GravityKit ends up being the answer, great. If it doesn’t, you’ll still walk away with a clearer picture of what to do next.

🤝 And if a call isn’t your thing

Just reply to this email. It comes straight to me, and I read every one. Tell me what you’re working on, what tripped you up, or what would have made you click “buy.”

Either way, thanks for taking a look at GravityKit. I hope our paths cross again.

Zack Katz
Founder, GravityKit
